name: the-traitors
description: Gerenciador e simulador de temporadas do reality The Traitors (monorepo: shared + backend + frontend + gateway)

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix shared && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix gateway
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix shared && npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix gateway
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix shared && npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix gateway
scripts.test:unit: npm test --prefix shared && npm test --prefix gateway && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.stack:down: docker compose --profile stack rm --stop --force web gateway api-1 api-2 worker migrate
